## Summary

Describe the problem and the specific change made.

## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature or improvement
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Maintenance

## Verification

- [ ] I reviewed the diff and removed unrelated changes.
- [ ] I ran the applicable checks, or explained why they could not be run.
- [ ] I updated relevant documentation where needed.

## Compatibility and ownership

- [ ] Existing public routes and behavior remain unchanged unless this PR explicitly changes them.
- [ ] No secrets, private user data, or unrelated assets are included.
- [ ] Any third-party code or assets are properly identified and licensed.
- [ ] Attribution reflects the work actually performed by each contributor.

## Notes

Document test results, known limitations, and any follow-up work.
